body.statement:
Whenever all focal inclusion probabilities are positive, the capsule kernel has the exact decomposition
\[
\Gamma_G=
\begin{pmatrix}K_{11}&-K_{10}\\-K_{01}&K_{00}\end{pmatrix}\succeq0,
\qquad
(\Gamma_G)_{uu}=\pi_u^{-1}-1,
\qquad
\|\Gamma_G\|_{\mathrm{op}}\ge\max_u(\pi_u^{-1}-1),
\]
where \(K_{ab}(i,j)=\operatorname{Cov}(X_{(i,a)}/\pi_{(i,a)},X_{(j,b)}/\pi_{(j,b)}\mid G)\).  Its incompatible opposite-arm entries equal \(1\), and equality of the two focal arm totals makes the all-ones vector a null vector when the inclusion probabilities are uniform.  It remains a conjecture whether there are universal constants \(c,C>0\) such that, uniformly along every sequence with \(d\to\infty\) and \(d=o(\sqrt n)\), with probability \(1-o(1)\) over \(G_n\),
\[
p_{\mathrm{acc}}(G)\ge1-n^{-4},
\qquad
c\frac{k}{n}\le\min_{u\in\mathcal U}\pi_u
\le\max_{u\in\mathcal U}\pi_u\le C\frac{k}{n},
\qquad
\|\Gamma_G\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le C\frac{n}{k}.
\]
No \(O(n/k)\) capsule norm bound is asserted as proved.
body.justification: This conjecture preserves the exact covariance identities and isolates the one operator estimate that would be needed for a sharper capsule theorem.
body.gap: No switching, mixing, or spectral argument currently controls the acceptance-conditioned compatible-pair block at order \(n/k\).
body.consumer: It is not a premise of any proved headline; it directs future work on whether the capsule can improve the published upper rate.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove or refute the high-probability acceptance, uniform inclusion, and \(O(n/k)\) covariance-operator bounds for the accepted symmetrized reservoir capsule on a typical simple random \(d\)-regular graph.
obligation.obstruction: The random compatible reservoir contributes weights involving \(\binom{|F_G(A)|}{k}^{-1}\). Fixed arm sizes cancel the exact constant mode only under uniform inclusion, while the heterogeneous residual is not controlled by the frozen random-regular assumptions; the Schur bound is only \(O(d^2+n/k)\).
obligation.attempted: The block covariance expansion, positive-semidefinite representation, diagonal lower bound, incompatible opposite-arm entries, and constant-mode cancellation were derived. Entrywise, Schur, and centered radius-two bounds all leave the logarithmic factor unresolved.
obligation.partial_result: The exact proved part is \(\Gamma_G=D\operatorname{Cov}(W\mid G)D\succeq0\), its arm-block decomposition, the identity \((\Gamma_G)_{uu}=\pi_u^{-1}-1\), the resulting lower bound \(\|\Gamma_G\|_{\mathrm{op}}\ge\max_u(\pi_u^{-1}-1)\), the value \(1\) on incompatible opposite-arm entries, and constant-mode cancellation when all inclusion probabilities are equal. Thus \(n/k\) is the smallest possible norm order if \(\pi_u\asymp k/n\). The missing result is the matching upper bound after acceptance conditioning.
